device.tuner: MaxLinear MxL603 family, by its wake-up: at start the application sets registers 0x0B and 0x12 of a chip at I2C 0x60 to 1 (the MxL603's tuner-enable and start-tune registers), exactly what the Strong SRT 8115's and Cabletech URZ0195's firmwares do before their first tune writes the MxL603 table; this firmware never tunes without channels, so the table itself was not seen

simulator.note: The simulator's first target; its application draws its first screen after a long start (run_dump_capture_screen.py, boot limit 45 min).  No navigation: its UI ignores the remote.  Without a signal none of the frame encodings tried (its 46-entry key table under the three codings, its bootloader's wake-code user codes 01 FE / 80 7F) changed the screen, although the frames are taken (the IR FIFO drains, the interrupt is acknowledged); with a signal (2026-10-10, sim.set_signal: the MxL603 model and the demodulator's lock) all 45 keys but POWER, pressed 18 s apart in the standard-NEC coding, changed nothing either -- the firmware keeps hopping between two channels (490 and 578 MHz, every 50 s or so; the banner's number redraws about 2100 pixels at each hop) as the Prima VIII does, its channel change never completing without the transport stream's tables.  With the demultiplexer model and a transport stream (2026-10-11, sim.attach_mux) it gets them: after the PAT it filters the PMT PID of its channel (0x6A5 = "TVP Opole" programme 0x11 at 578 MHz, 0x321 = "Polsat Sport News" 0x1A at 490 MHz, from its channel database), then the CAT, SDT, NIT, EIT and the video / audio PIDs, and consumes every packet the model writes -- its banner then shows the model's EIT ("Now: 02:00-03:00 TVP Opole now" where it said "Нет Информации", no information).  Without a PMT it moves to the next channel after 2 minutes, with a PMT of the wrong programme number after 30 s, with the right one after 20 s -- so what it waits for last is the video or audio stream itself, which the simulator has no source for; until then the remote stays dead.

desc: p.kaczmarek2's Comsat TE 1050 HD, read with a CH341 programmer for the elektroda article of December 2025 on the box's inside, the firmware read-out and the flash partition format.
The application's system-information page names it "M3801", "MC6379-VER1.0", "TE 1050 HD", "DVB-T HD V1.1.5", "Jan 29 2013".  Application: Libcore 8.1c.0@SDK4.0bd.8.7_20121127.

Tuner: the application initialises the chip's two hardware I2C masters (0xB8018200, 0xB8018700; i2c_scb.py) at start and, on the first, wakes a tuner at I2C address 0x60 (registers 0x0B and 0x12 set to 0x01) -- and nothing more until a channel is tuned, which it never does with its empty channel list; the demodulator is the chip's own (the firmware's "NIM_S3811_0").  The driver names no tuner in its strings (none of the M3801 firmwares does); the register table it writes at the first tune would identify the chip.
